name_reason: This is literally the C entry point that the Watcom CRT startup (__CMain @ 0x45D4B) calls via main(argc, argv) and whose EAX it consumes as the DOS exit code. It MUST carry the exact name `main` for the CRT entry contract and the src-only FD2.EXE link; it is the one game function explicitly exempt from the fd2_ prefix convention (documented in CLAUDE.md / MEMORY and in both the src and Ghidra plate comments). No address residue. Keep.
purpose: FD2 game C entry point: performs one-shot startup (AIL sound init, resource loads, work-buffer mallocs, mode-13h set, RNG warm-up) then runs the outer main-menu / inner gameplay loop until quit, finally tearing down sound and restoring text video mode.
logic_summary: One-shot init: AIL_startup; install MDI (BGM) driver and, if present, set available flag + allocate sequence handle; install DIG (SFX) driver and, if present, set available flag + allocate two sample handles. Eight fd2_load_dat_resource loads from FDOTHER.DAT (indices 0x1F,1,2,3,4,5,6) plus one FDTXT.DAT (index 0), each passing the prior pointer so the loader frees-then-reloads. Three work-buffer mallocs (0x20 tile-event flags, 0x25680 large state buffer, 0xA00 menu roster). Set INT 10h AX=0x0013 (VGA mode 13h) via int386 over the shared REGS union. Latch BIOS tick word [0x46C] into the ambient-palette timer. RNG warm-up: advance fd2_advance_rng_state() rand()%256 times (under FD2_REPLAY the warm-up count is forced to 0 for determinism). Outer loop: set main-menu BGM (track 0x12) and call fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher; if it returns 0, run the inner gameplay loop: fd2_game_main_loop, then branch on data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (@0x53ECC): ==1 -> play chapter-clear fanfare; ==2 -> run the current chapter's end handler, present the chapter-transition menu, and on continue run the next chapter's init handler + set its turn BGM (otherwise request quit); both reset the end-code and toggle the play-active flag. -1 results request quit. On quit: AIL_shutdown, set INT 10h AX=0x0003 (text mode 3), return.

returns.semantics: Original source is void main(void): the body neither uses argc/argv nor produces a return value. The Watcom CRT bridge __CMain pushes (argv, argc) and consumes EAX as the DOS exit code (PUSH EAX; JMP _exit), but those are the CRT calling-convention artifacts (the Ghidra decompile shows phantom param_1/param_2 the body ignores), not part of the source contract. Emitted as a normal void function (pipeline_spec pattern A); Watcom regenerates an equivalent epilogue.

notes: Caller-context check: sole caller __CMain @ 0x45D4B (xref UNCONDITIONAL_CALL from 0x45D8C) does main(argc, argv) then PUSH EAX; JMP exit, confirming the CRT entry-point contract that fixes the name to `main`. Source signature is void main(void) and the body ignores the pushed argc/argv, so params=[]; the Ghidra-side phantom param_1/param_2 (argc/argv) are CRT-ABI artifacts, not source parameters, and are out of scope for the canonical void signature. Src comment (lines 14-46) and Ghidra plate are both accurate, ASCII-only, consistent, and written as final conclusions (C entry point, fd2_-prefix exemption rationale, one-shot init breakdown, main-loop structure) -- left unchanged. No logic touched; rename judgement only (keep).
